MelonExpress

A monkey, a flying watermelon train, and a town full of people who need a ride.

How to play
WASDDrive and steer (arrow keys work too) SpaceHold to fly up, let go to sink. Shift dives. FSpit watermelon seeds HHonk: riders close by jump in
Left thumbDrag anywhere on the left to steer and drive FlyHold to climb, let go to sink Spit, HonkSeeds fight birds and UFOs. Honking pulls riders in.

Fly low over people to scoop them up. Their diamond’s color is their stop, and the arrow points the way. Every drop-off buys more time.
